reviews.title: Excellent App
reviews.text: I’m a beginner and have no idea what I’m doing. This app though, has truly helped me to explore exercises and techniques I never knew existed. I am also able to easily keep track of what I’m doing and keep a routine. The AI is also surprisingly good. It accurately reflects any prompt I make for specific exercises or machines I wish to use. The only downside, is that it isn’t as intuitive as I would like. It has a learning curve to figure out, but ultimately it’s worth it.
